desc: Read input N, M and the edges.
Build an adjacency list for the graph.
Use BFS or DFS to identify connected components and determine the bipartite partition sizes (count of nodes in set 0 and set 1) for each component.
For each connected component, calculate the maximum number of edges possible in its complete bipartite form: `count0 * count1`.
Subtract the number of existing edges that belong to each component to get the number of remaining valid moves for that component.
Sum the remaining valid moves across all components. If the total is odd, print "Aoki"; otherwise, print "Takahashi".
